FAQ

Common questions

Still wondering? Write to hello@songgift.com.

How does it actually work?

Tell us about the person and the occasion, pick a mood and genre, and we write original lyrics from your story. You edit until every line feels right, then we create the finished song — usually in under three minutes.

Is every song unique?

Yes. Every song is written from scratch using your story. The lyrics, melody, and arrangement are all original. No two songs are ever the same.

Can I change the lyrics?

Absolutely. You review, edit, and request rewrites until every line is right. The song is only created after you approve the words.

How long does it take?

Lyrics are ready in about 30 seconds. The finished song takes 2–3 minutes after you approve the words.

What genres are available?

Pop, acoustic, R&B/soul, country, jazz, and electronic — each paired with moods like happy, romantic, emotional, playful, or calm.

How do I send it to someone?

Every song gets its own listening page with a unique link. Send it by text, email, or any messaging app. You can also download the MP3.

Who is this song for?

Take a few minutes. Think of someone. We'll help you turn the feeling into something they can hear.
